title: Online Certificate Verification & Credential Authenticity | techcadd Lucknow
metaDescription: Official credential verification portal for techcadd Lucknow. Employers, HR recruiters, background verification agencies (BGV) and universities can verify ISO 9001:2015 training certificates and corporate internship letters by candidate roll number.

hero.text: For corporate HR departments, background verification agencies (BGV), government bodies, and university registrars. Verify the authenticity of ISO 9001:2015 certificates and corporate internship letters issued by techcadd Lucknow.

formCard.heading: Verify Student Credential
formCard.text: Enter the candidate roll number exactly as printed on the certificate or internship letter.

logic: NO real lookup: there is no API call or database. On submit, if the trimmed value is non-empty, it always shows a success box; editing the input hides it again. Success box: check icon + 'Registry Record Found: Roll ID {INPUT.toUpperCase()}' and text 'Candidate registration is confirmed on the official techcadd training database. For authorized corporate background verification (BGV) sign-off documents on official letterhead, please email info@techcadd.com or call our corporate desk at {{phone}}.' The email link is mailto:info@techcadd.com?subject=BGV%20Verification%20Request%20-%20{encodeURIComponent(input)}. Any rebuild should consider a real registry lookup (or at least not claim a record was found).

result.successText: Candidate registration is confirmed on the official techcadd training database. For authorized corporate background verification (BGV) sign-off documents on official letterhead, please email info@techcadd.com or call our corporate desk at {{phone}}.

data.bgvNote: For Corporate BGV Requests: You can also email scanned copies of the candidate credential directly to info@techcadd.com with the candidate consent letter for written verification on official letterhead.

sections.heading: How the Credential Validation Works
sections.text: Standardized verification process designed to ensure speed, accuracy, and legal compliance for enterprise hiring teams.

steps.title: Locate Candidate Roll Number
steps.text: Check the top-right corner of the official techcadd certificate or industrial internship experience letter for the unique alphanumeric registration code (e.g., TCM-2026-XXXX).

steps.title: Submit Verification Request
steps.text: Enter the candidate roll number below or email our Corporate Relations & Verification Desk with candidate authorization consent.

steps.title: Immediate Record Validation
steps.text: Our secure registry validates candidate name, course discipline, training tenure, live capstone project details, and letter issue date.

steps.title: Official HR Confirmation
steps.text: Corporate BGV agencies receive an official digital sign-off report within 24 to 48 business hours with registrar verification stamp.

sections.heading: Security Features on Every techcadd Credential
sections.text: We maintain strict physical and digital security protocols on all training certificates and internship letters.

items.title: Unique Alphanumeric Roll Number
items.text: Each credential features an untamperable registry serial mapped to the student's biometric attendance and project submission archive.

items.title: ISO 9001:2015 Accreditation Hologram
items.text: Certified quality management standard ensuring standardized assessment, syllabus compliance, and authorized corporate issuance.

items.title: Verifiable Internship Letter
items.text: Documents live production engineering project tenure, mentor sign-off, software stack proficiency, and code contributions.

items.title: Centralized Registry Database
items.text: Backed by persistent digital logs accessible to enterprise recruitment teams across India and international immigration authorities.

sections.heading: Need Priority Verification for Urgent Onboarding?
sections.text: Our verification officer is available during centre hours, 9 AM to 6 PM, to process corporate background checks.
